rules.title: Cleartext (HTTP) traffic explicitly enabled
rules.description: The app sets android:usesCleartextTraffic="true", permitting unencrypted HTTP. Traffic can be read or modified on the network (CWE-319). Serve over HTTPS and set usesCleartextTraffic="false".

rules.title: No Network Security Config declared
rules.description: No android:networkSecurityConfig is declared, so cleartext permission and trust-anchor policy fall back to platform defaults (CWE-319). Add a res/xml Network Security Config that sets cleartextTrafficPermitted="false" and scopes trust anchors.
